description: This file implements the DateCalculationEngine class, providing methods for date arithmetic such as adding/subtracting durations and calculating date differences, with special handling for Japanese calendar system.

classes.name: DateCalculationEngine
classes.description: Provides methods for date calculations including addition, subtraction, and difference computation, with special handling for Japanese calendar system.

methods.name: AddDuration
methods.description: Adds a specified duration to a start date, handling Japanese calendar system by converting to Gregorian before calculation.

methods.name: SubtractDuration
methods.description: Subtracts a specified duration from a start date, with Japanese calendar system conversion.

methods.name: TryGetDateDifference
methods.description: Calculates the difference between two dates in years, months, weeks, and days.

methods.name: GetDifferenceInDays
methods.description: Calculates the number of days between two DateTime values.

methods.name: TryGetCalendarDaysInMonth
methods.description: Retrieves the number of days in the month of a given date.

methods.name: TryGetCalendarDaysInYear
methods.description: Retrieves the number of days in the year of a given date.

methods.name: AdjustCalendarDate
methods.description: Adjusts a date by a specified amount of years, months, or weeks, handling Japanese calendar system conversion.
